original.statement: Support for configuring dnsPolicy and dnsConfig through template sections has been added to Strimzi Kafka CRDs.

decision.reason: [ev-99017d1c8007] describes a purely additive, opt-in capability, and the CRD schema comparison [ev-5d73e704055d, ev-d758a7cb99a4] confirms spec.kafka.template.pod.dnsPolicy is new in the kafka.strimzi.io Kafka v1beta2 schema. With the consequence fixed at none/informational, scoping applicability to environments using the Kafka v1beta2 kind matches the fixed subject and creates no mandatory work. Confidence is low because no canonical exposure exists for added fields, and the changelog's generic 'template sections' wording may also cover other kinds that the evidence shown does not prove.
